ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Reg Add Open Command
ruleDefinitions.description: Threat actors performed dumping of SAM, SECURITY and SYSTEM registry hives using DelegateExecute key

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*reg.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*hkcu\\\\software\\\\classes\\\\ms\\-settings\\\\shell\\\\open\\\\command.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ve\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*reg.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*hkcu\\\\software\\\\classes\\\\ms\\-settings\\\\shell\\\\open\\\\command.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*DelegateExecute.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*reg.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*delete.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*hkcu\\\\software\\\\classes\\\\ms\\-settings.*")))
